LESSON: NON- METALLIC MATERIALS

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES
Strand: Materials for Production
Topic 3.3: Non- Metallic Materials

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Non- Metallic Materials
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
